text_block_list.text:
The Fan Fest—a festival where
Umamusume fans
from all over gather at
Tracen Academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Crowds of fans flock to catch a glimpse
of Super
Creek and Тамамо Кросс, two
major contestants
butting heads at the
spring Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Creek! You and your trainer
got a real
big weakness!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You're not gonna be able to run well in
the Tenno
Sho unless ya fix it!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hah! You're not even a tiny bit scared,
are ya?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Well, even if you say we've got a
weakness, I
think we're the best duo
there is!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
We've overcome everything in our way
to make it
this far.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. You two really are
somethin'.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But it's thinkin' you're the best that's
your
weakness. Now, listen up.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Why do Umamusume run? Everyone's
got their
own reasons, but y'know what?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
We all got somethin' in common—there's

somethin' we all want.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Victory, glory, or just pure mastery...
Everyone's
got some kinda goal...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But you two got nothin'! Why? 'Cause
you were
already done when ya met.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Yup. Creek's happy spoilin' ya, and
you're happy
bein' spoiled.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Ya both got whatcha want already,
yeah? You
don't need nothin' else!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Look at me though... I'm runnin' for my
family.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
For my li'l bro and sis who can barely
keep their
bellies full.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
No way ya can run like me when you're
already
satisfied! Whaddya got to run
for?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс is very convincing. I can't
even
attempt to refute her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... I had no idea. Then I...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll cook for your little brother and sister
too!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: That's not the point! But whatever.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Those reasons aside, it'd be annoyin' if
the ditzy
duo could do everythin', right?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
It don't bother me either way, but the
fans hate a
Mary Sue, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Us? A ditzy duo?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Is that how people see us, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I'm as surprised to hear it as you are.

text_block_list.text:
What?! The two of ya are like a happily
married
couple!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, everybody? Ya want
'em to sink,
right?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
That's right! They're so sweet my teeth
hurt just
thinking about them!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: Knock 'em down a peg, Тамамо Кросс!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
The cheers from the crowd seem to favor
Tamamo
Cross.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Heheh! If it's hungry versus lovey-dovey,
then
hungry gets the respect.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You two already got everythin', so ya
got no
future. Whatcha gonna do now?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: No way! This duo rocks!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: I stan them both!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Say what now?! They've got more
support than I
expected. They already
got their cake! Y'all really
wanna watch
'em eat it too?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Su-per Creek! Su-per Creek! Su-per
Creek!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, looks like ya got popularity on
your side.
We'll see what they think after
this race!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
If you think your lovey-doveyness is
enough to
beat a hunger-driven run like
mine, then you're in
for a shock!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Support from the fans for the two
runners is split
right in half.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Will we be able to find a way to
overcome
Тамамо Кросс's hunger-driven
determination to
win by the time the
Tenno Sho rolls around?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс shoulders the burden of
her family.
Will we find an appropriate
response to her by
the time the Tenno
Sho rolls around?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
